events.title: The Yard: Escape from Prison Demo is Now Live – Play for Free!
events.summary: Hey inmates!The wait is over! The official demo for The Yard: Escape from Prison is officially live and free to play right now on Steam!Get a taste of what life behind bars feels like—and more importantly, how you’re going to escape it. Whether you play solo, on the couch with a friend via split-screen, or online in up to 6-player co-op, your journey to freedom starts today!What you can experience in the Demo:Follow the Routine: Stick to daily chores, attend roll calls, and stay under the radar
